entities.name: Fluoro-hydroxyacetophenone
observations: Input substrate resolves to CC(=O)c1cc(F)ccc1O, a fluoro-hydroxyacetophenone with one phenolic OH.
The phenolic oxygen is the transferable functional group in the reaction.

entities.name: Triflic anhydride
observations: Input reagent resolves to triflic anhydride, Tf2O, O=S(=O)(OS(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F)C(F)(F)F.

entities.name: Pyridine
observations: Input component resolves to pyridine and functions as base/nucleophilic activator during phenolic triflation.

entities.name: Aryl triflate product
observations: The product forms by replacing phenolic O-H with O-S(=O)2-CF3 and is suitable as a later cross-coupling handle.

entities.name: Phenolic O-triflation
observations: Triflic anhydride transfers a triflyl group to the phenolic oxygen, generating an aryl O-triflate.
The evidence is analogical to related phenols; no exact yield or exact-condition record was returned for this substrate.
